overview: SaaS provider that embeds automated summarization + tagging into customer inboxes used by mid-market retailers. Looking to replace current lambda-based summarizer (latency issues) with a production-grade inference platform capable of consistent output during promotional spikes.

requirements_summary: Workload: short-form ticket and multi-email thread summarization (avg thread length 8 msgs)
Targets: tail latency <150ms for single-turn summarization; throughput: sustained 6k rps with 15k rps spikes
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to trade 10-15% cost for reliability during spikes
Models: prefer open models with quantized variants; want ability to route to cheaper gen for low-priority tickets
Routing/fallback: must have automatic fallback to smaller/quantized model + graceful degradation (no failures to agent UI)
Integrations: Zendesk + Freshdesk workflows, macros, and webhooks; Slack/Teams notifications for failed auto-tags
Audit: full per-ticket audit logging + retention controls; ability to redact PII on ingest
notes: AE notes: customer already built homegrown summarizer; main pain = reliability during promotional spikes and noisy threads
Quote from CPO: 'We need summaries that agents trust — not just short, but actionable. If it suggests wrong tags, agents lose trust.'
POC scope agreed: 2 production-ish hours/day mirrored traffic, historical replay of Black Friday sample, tagging taxonomy mapping
Legal: standard DPA + addendum for EU residency asked (expected review 1 week)
Ops ask: need an SLA for inference latency and clear escalation path during incidents
